name: View Task List
description: The user opens the app and sees all their tasks displayed in a list. This is the default state of the app — no action is required to trigger it. The user can see each task's title, due date, status, and an overdue indicator for past-due tasks.
preconditions: The app is open in the browser

main_flow.description: Displays tasks in a list, each with title, due date, status, and overdue indicator

alternative_flows.name: No tasks yet
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 2, no tasks exist in storage
steps: System displays an empty state with the message 'No tasks yet.' and an Add Task prompt

alternative_flows.name: Load fails
alternative_flows.trigger: At step 1, tasks cannot be fetched
steps: System displays an error banner with a retry option

postconditions: The user can see all their tasks on screen
business_rules: All tasks are shown by default with no filter applied
Tasks with a due date in the past are marked as overdue regardless of their status

bdd_scenarios.given: The user has tasks saved in the app
bdd_scenarios.then: All tasks are displayed with their title, due date, status, and overdue indicator where applicable

bdd_scenarios.given: The user has no tasks saved
bdd_scenarios.then: An empty state is shown with the message 'No tasks yet.' and an Add Task prompt

bdd_scenarios.given: The app cannot reach the data source
bdd_scenarios.then: An error banner is displayed with a retry option
